persona.name: Noor Bellamy
persona.summary: An invented backend engineer at a small logistics firm in Bristol (they/them), early 2026. Works on Atlas, the firm's shipment-tracking service. Builds hearth, a home-automation side project on a Raspberry Pi, takes an evening Rust course, plans a trek in the Atlas Mountains with a friend, and chats with AI tools about running, sourdough and everyday life. Six simulated weeks, 5 January to 13 February 2026.

projects.name: Atlas
projects.description: The work shipment-tracking service (Python, FastAPI, Postgres) at Fernleigh Freight. Not the Atlas Mountains trek.

projects.name: hearth
projects.description: A home-automation side project on a Raspberry Pi: sensors, MQTT, a heating schedule, a small Rust bridge service.
